# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 16 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launches & Private Market

- **Orchard Boulevard GLS site awarded at S$1,755 psf ppr** - URA has awarded the Orchard Boulevard Government Land Sale site to Intrepid Investments and TID Residential (a Hong Leong–TID joint venture) for S$181.86 million, or approximately S$1,755 psf per plot ratio. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hong-leong-tid-jv-top-bids-orchard-boulevard-gls-site-at-s1755-psf-ppr/)

- **Lentor area now has 3,400 new homes; early Lentor Modern buyers averaged $314K gain** - A review of all seven new Lentor condos covers land prices, sales volumes, sub-sale gains and rental performance, with Lentor Modern's early buyers recording an average gain of $314K. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/lentor-moderns-early-buyers-made-312k-on-average-how-all-7-new-lentor-condos-have-done-so-far-2/)

- **Family forfeited $30,000 on new launch OTP to buy resale instead** - A family gave up their option on a new launch condo in Ang Mo Kio, forfeiting $30,000, and purchased a 1,259 sq ft three-bedroom resale unit at Kerrisdale for $2 million. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/forfeited-30000-new-launch-condo-buy/)

## HDB Resale & BTO

- **November BTO draws over 35,600 applications; two-room flats hit record demand** - The November 2026 BTO exercise received more than 35,600 applications — the highest application rate since 2022 — with two-room flats attracting a record number of applicants across seven projects offering 7,964 flats. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/november-bto-draws-35600-applications-two/)

- **Yishun's first S$1.3M HDB resale: executive flat at Block 652 Yishun Avenue 4 sells for S$1,328,888** - An executive apartment in Yishun changed hands for S$1,328,888 in November 2026, becoming the most expensive HDB resale transaction ever recorded in the town and the first to cross the S$1.3 million mark. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/yishun-hdb-resale-record-nee-soon-central-view/)

- **February 2027 BTO launch previewed: Bishan, Toa Payoh, Tampines and Tengah** - HDB's upcoming February 2027 BTO exercise is expected to offer around 4,300 flats across four estates, with a site-by-site review of anticipated prices and demand levels now available. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/review-february-2027-bto-launch-sites/)
